Pardon the exclamation point, but this is really interesting. What the President posted was actually a very professionally produced video about the endocannabinoid system, and how it will revolutionize healthcare, especially for seniors.

 

It was actually created by, The Commonwealth Group.

They introduce themselves, saying, “The Commonwealth Project is working to prioritize the 65+ population by integrating medical cannabis into mainstream health care for seniors. Our efforts are driven by a philanthropic and compassionate desire to assist millions of seniors facing increasingly complex health issues as they age.

 

“While this colossal uptick will see 4.1 million Americans enter their golden years by the end of 2027, it will also see a massive jump in demand for advanced medical care and enrollments in already-strained programs like Medicare.

As the ‘peak 65’ population unleashes a tidal wave across our health care systems, we need to radically rethink senior health care.”

First, they are definitely talking about my generation, which has been lied to the longest, and is the only generation that still supports prohibition, but needs cannabis more than any other.

See AMA Reports More Seniors Using Marijuana. Maybe It’s Because Common Drugs That They Prescribe Are Tied to Increased Risk of Cognitive Decline In Seniors But Marijuana Helps.

The fact that the President of the United States introduced this program on his own social media network makes it even more important. Plus, it is hitting in the middle of the debate about rescheduling marijuana, to move it from Schedule 1, meaning that it has no medical use, to Schedule 3, where it can be prescribed.
